_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-74 directional-move record in this coil regime makes HOLD the statistically dominant call; both brains see coiling tension but neither has a confirmed breaker, so patience wins until price or flow data resolves the range.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call Denial as current phase, but analyst forward-calls Disbelief with HOLD direction while narrative leans bullish accumulation; the analyst's higher trust weight and superior coil-regime track record tip consensus toward HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $66K with funding rising above 0.01% and ETF flows flipping positive with DXY breaking below 99
